body.name: CertGluePFL search and certification handle
body.construction: Enumerate the finite classes \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\), exact rational incidence forests for the flattened nonempty components \(v,b\), their projection back to semantic labels \(v\), rational action probabilities, and finite rational atomic dual measures; enclose every weighted Gaussian integral outward; repair the best semantic-label primal exactly; and increase the core, chart, atom, cut, and precision indices according to the certified ledger until \(U_{\varepsilon}-L_{\varepsilon}\le\varepsilon\).
